verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and SSH/Mosh client that also offers a coding experience by connecting to VS Code for web, Codespaces or GitPod, so git tooling is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no dedicated multi-file merge-conflict resolution tool of Blink's own. Any merge tooling would come from the connected VS Code host, which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resolve merge conflicts across many files at once with a dedicated tool
